subject: 6th Grade Cookie Dough Fundraiser - Help Fund Our End-of-Year Activities!
text_body:
Dear 6th Grade Families,

It's that time of year! Our annual 6th Grade Cookie Dough Fundraiser is officially underway. All proceeds go directly toward end-of-year activities including the 6th grade promotion ceremony, class party, and the overnight science camp trip.

HOW IT WORKS:
- Each tub of gourmet cookie dough is $16.00
- Flavors available: Chocolate Chip, Snickerdoodle, Peanut Butter, Oatmeal Raisin, and Double Chocolate
- Your child earns a prize for every 5 tubs sold
- Top 3 sellers get a special pizza party!

IMPORTANT DATES:
- Fundraiser starts: TODAY, October 1
- All order forms and money due: Wednesday, October 15
- Cookie dough delivery: November 7 (just in time to freeze before Thanksgiving!)
- Make checks payable to: Lincoln Elementary 6th Grade Fund

TIPS FOR SELLING:
- Share with family, friends, neighbors, and coworkers
- Don't forget about out-of-town relatives - they can order too!
- Use the online sharing link on your order form
- Remind buyers the dough freezes well for up to 6 months

Our goal is for each student to sell at least 10 tubs. If every family participates, we can fully fund science camp for every 6th grader!

Questions? Contact me at kthompson@lincolnelementary.edu or stop by Room 14.

Let's make this our best fundraiser yet!

Mrs. Karen Thompson
6th Grade Teacher & Fundraiser Coordinator
